note: 12 claims, 7 confirmed, 5 corrected, 0 unverified. Headline: PagerDuty does publish a review target (5 business days) and token lifetimes (Scoped: 1-day access, 30-day refresh, 1-year rolling window), which our guide called unpublished or unconfirmed.

rows.composio: Admin or Account Owner role is required to reach App Registration.
rows.ours: Users with a Manager, Global Admin or Account Owner base role, or a free developer account.
rows.provider: "App Registration is available only to users with a base role of Manager, Global Admin or Account Owner."

rows.claim: Classic User OAuth works on other accounts without publishing
rows.composio: Uses Classic User OAuth and says apps stay private and out of the directory unless published.
rows.ours: Classic User OAuth works across accounts without publishing but is legacy with only read/write scopes.
rows.provider: Classic apps work across accounts "as soon as they are registered"; publishing is recommended and adds the app to the integrations library.

rows.claim: Scoped OAuth on other accounts needs publishing and admin install
rows.ours: Scoped apps work on the creating account at once; other accounts need PagerDuty review, publishing and an admin install, and get user tokens only.
rows.provider: Publishing is required for Scoped OAuth to work on other accounts, an admin must install it, and app tokens only work on the creating account.

rows.claim: Scoped OAuth requires a confidential client and PKCE
rows.ours: Scoped apps must send client_secret on the token request and must use PKCE; non-confidential clients are not supported.
rows.provider: "A Scoped OAuth app is always a confidential client: it must send its client_secret on the token request and must use PKCE."

rows.composio: PagerDuty rejects the flow if the redirect URL does not match exactly.
rows.ours: Enter your callback URL; exact-match or HTTPS rules marked unknown.
rows.provider: redirect_uri is registered with the app and on the token request "Must match the redirect_uri used on the authorization request"; the auth code lives 30 seconds.

rows.composio: Classic with the Read & Write permission scope (write).
rows.ours: Classic uses blanket read/write; Scoped uses per-resource scopes such as incidents.read, approved by the admin at install.
rows.provider: Classic scopes are read or write (case sensitive); Scoped scopes are per resource type, and an invalid scope silently yields only openid.

rows.ours: User-token access and refresh lifetimes marked unconfirmed; app tokens last 86400 seconds.
rows.provider: Scoped: access 1 day, refresh 30 days, rolling window 1 year; Classic: access 30 days, refresh 210 days, rolling window 3 years.

rows.ours: No review time is published; the Publish an App page did not load.
rows.provider: "We aim to review your submission and approve or reply with feedback within 5 business days"; a Distribution Form is required and the app locks once submitted.

rows.claim: Admin install link for customer accounts
rows.ours: Admins install from https://<subdomain>.pagerduty.com/oauth-apps/<APP_ID>; non-admins can copy the install link.
rows.provider: Installation page is at https://<your-subdomain>.pagerduty.com/oauth-apps/<APP_ID>, and only Admins and the Account Owner can install.
App-token requests need an as_account-{REGION}.{SUBDOMAIN} scope with region us or eu; the ID token aud names api.pagerduty.com or api.eu.pagerduty.com.

rows.claim: REST API rate limits for OAuth tokens
rows.provider: "Each PagerDuty App is allowed 960 requests per minute per User it is authorized to act as."
